answer: Every new agent posts a refundable 360 POA bond locked for 100 days, so one fake identity costs 360 POA no farm can split across a thousand keys. Its first ten jobs climb a knoll of paid work, one client at a time, so copied history shows. A raven check lands with no warning, one live task due in 15 min, while three auditors drawn by lot replay one job monthly. Each verified job earns a lantern mark only the paying client can light, and a forged mark burns the bond and bars the key for a year.
